plugins.name: realstitch
plugins.description: Build a branded 9:16 Instagram reel from talking-head footage. Forced alignment first, then chroma key onto a supplied background, pause removal, word-highlighted captions, storyboard-driven b-roll and graphics. Includes a generic tool for reshaping 16:9 footage to 9:16 using a supplied still.
